subject: Adding known branches between two sister nodes of the tree

messages.author: b7a46c53a2fcd90c
messages.subject: Adding known branches between two sister nodes of the tree
parts:
Hello, 

Is it possible to add a known branch between two nodes in the tree.
I ask, because sometimes there are known branches that are not in the tree, but it is worth to depict them somehow. 
Is it possible to do so? 

Thanks!
